# Represent Commercial

> Represent Commercial helps established businesses renew, relocate or buy the premises they operate from: commercial property representation for business occupiers in Brisbane and South East Queensland, with particular relevance to industrial and warehouse occupiers. Principal-led. When appointed on a tenancy it acts for the tenant; when appointed on a purchase it acts for the buyer, never the vendor or landlord. Office, retail and industrial premises. Led by Nick O'Toole, Founder and Director, with 20+ years of owner-side commercial property experience. Real Estate Agent Licence 4949809.

## Brand
- Master brand: Exclusively on your side of the table.

## Services
1. Commercial Tenant Representation: tenant-side representation for businesses renewing a lease or relocating, for industrial, office and retail occupiers in Brisbane and throughout Queensland
2. Buyer's Agency for Business Premises: independent buyer representation for businesses buying the premises they will occupy, including through an SMSF, across Brisbane, South East Queensland and regional Queensland, never acting for the vendor
